description: Updates for the example apps. CI runs the browser tests against each, so a release that breaks Spotnote shows up as a failing PR.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of every example app: one PR a week.
Apps that stay on an older major, of the framework or of Vite: no major updates.
The newest Svelte stays on Vite 7 (Vite 8 has its React, Vue, Solid and Astro apps): a new Svelte major opens a PR, a new Vite major doesn't.
React Router 8 stays on Vite 7 (Vite 8 has its own apps): a new React Router major opens a PR, a new Vite major doesn't.
A new major on the newest app of a framework (React 20, Astro 8): the cue to keep this app on the old major as an app of its own, and move this one up (see the examples-new-framework skill).
